tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru/ gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma la sogs pa dpon g.yog lnga'i sgrub pa'i lag khrid dang*/ srog gi snying po dang*/ dngos grub gang ster ba rnams rje btsun la phul ba ltar/ bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bdag nyid bsgom/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs la/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas la/ dri zhim po'i chu dang*/ tsan+dan dang*/ gu gul dang*/ spos sna tshogs dang*/ a ka ru dang*/ du ru ka la sogs pa maṇ+ḍal la byugs la gru bzhi rin po che'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ drwa ba drwa phyed me tog gis brgyan pa/ dbus su rin po che las byas pa'i ga'u kha sbyar ba'i nang du/ sgrub pa po rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa'am rang gi ming bris la/ tshe dang longs spyod spel/ dbang thang rgyas par mdzad du gsol bya ba bris te/ srog gi snying po 'di mtshan thog thag gcig la bsgrub par bya'o// oṃ

sgrub thabs gzhan tu/ oṃ a ka ni tsa li mi thu phri le te swā hā/ ka na wa ti mi thun nan yi ri swā hā/ de ltar sgrub pa byas nas/ de'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro// yod na tsan+dan gyi chu'i pū dza dbul bar bya'o// gang tshe ring ma'i gzugs su mthong na bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas bcud len ster/ gser gyi dong rtse nyis brgya sum brgya ster/ yang na sring mo'i lus su 'ongs nas/ tshe sgrub pa'i bcud len ster zhing lha'i bu bu mo rnams kyang ster ro// dus gsum du gtam yang zlos par byed do// yang na chung ma'i lus su 'ongs nas nor gyi bdag po chen por 'gyur ro// yid la 'dod pa thams cad ster bar 'gyur ro// mdor na lha'i longs spyod kyang ster bar 'gyur ro// dbang phyug kyang sbyin par byed do// gtso mo tshe ring ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i srog gi sgrub thabs bstan pa ni/ chu klung gi 'gram du song la tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal byas la/ mchod pa chen po byas shing*/ a ka ru nag po'i dud pa phul te/ nyin re bzhin sngags ni khri khri bzla bar bya'o// oṃ oṃ na tri ma tri du ru ma tri swāhā zhes pa'ang snang*/ na tri ma tra su ru sa ma ti swā hā/ de nas zhag bdun phrag gnyis pa'i nam phyed nas cis kyang 'ong ngo*// 'ongs nas kyang sgrub pa po la gang la gang 'dod pa ster ro// mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma'i sgrub thabs la/ shing mya ngan med pa'i 'og tu 'dug ste/ maṇ+ḍal rje btsun ma ḍā ki 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul zhing zas su sha za zhing*/ bdug pa dang*/ me tog dang*/ dri dang gtor ma la sogs pas mchod/ nyin re la sngags stong phrag re brjod par bya'o// oṃ oṃ a ni ni ma ta ra ki ni mi thun phri li ri ye swā hā/ zhes pa'ang gda'/ a nan+ta ḍā ki nī mi thun nan phri li swā hā/

zla ba gcig gi khongs su nges par 'ongs nas ma dang sring mo chung ma'i las byed par 'gyur ro// rgyan dang*/ bcud dang*/ bcud len sgrub pa skyong ba'i sgom pa srung ba dang*/ nyi ma re re bzhin 'dod pa'i zhal zas dang gser zho brgya brgya ster ba dang*/ sring mor gyur nas/ dpag tshad stong nas kyang lha'i bu mo blangs nas ster bar 'gyur ro// gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// ༈ /mi g.yo glang bzang ma'i sgrub thabs la/ rang gi khyim gyi sa phyogs tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal byas te gu gul gyi dud pas bdug tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ ji srid tshes bco lnga'i bar du nyi ma re bzhin/ oṃ dha ka sa dha oṃ ḍā ki sa pa ri tsakra mu ni tiṣ+ṭha rbad lo swā hā/ zhes pa'ang snang*/ sa ri tsakra mu ni tiṣ+ṭha rbad nan swā hā/ sngags stong phrag re re bzlas te/ de nas zla ba phyed nas ci tsam 'byor pa'i pū tsa byas nas/ ji srid nam phyed kyi bar du bzlas pa byas na/ dngos grub nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro// mi g.yo glang bzang ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// ༈ /cod pan mgrin bzang ma'i sgrub thabs la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms byas nas// rang nyid nub tu 'dug par bya// maṇ+ḍal la sogs sngon ma bzhin// dam rdzas sha chen gtor ma bcas// spos chen la sogs bsreg par bya// maṇ+ḍal dbus su sha chen dang*// de'i nang zhing chen pags pa la// bsgrub bya'i ling ga ming rus bya// dug dang gri khrag dag gis bri// seng ldeng phur pa sor bdun pas// dmigs pa'i tsit+ta'i nang du gdab// nub tu khros pa'i sems ldan pas// gsang sngags rab tu bzla bar bya// oṃ da oṃ ḍā ki nī kan+d+ra pa ni mā ra ya dzaḥ zhes pa'ang gda'/ kri ka ra ta ka u pa kra ni mā ra ya badz+ra swā hā/ khri phrag gcig gis mā ra ya// tshes gcig bzlas pa'i them pa dang*// rū pa phur bu dang bcas te// nub phyogs gangs kyi lto ba ru// gan rkyal dag tu mnan par bya// yang na brag dang chu 'thab bar du mnan// sgrub la bar du gcod pa dang*// bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang*// chos 'khor nyams par byed pa na// sgrub pa 'di la 'bad par bya// gzhan du byas na dam tshig nyams// nyams len sgrub pa bskyang ba dang*// sgom chen bar chad bsrung ba dang*// longs spyod bcud len ster ba yi// rdzas rnams 'grub par the tshom med// bstan pa'i spyi dgra 'dul ba'o// nyams len gdams pa'i yi ge 'di// rje btsun nyid la srog snying phul// ngan rdzong bo dhi rā dza dang*// ras pa zhi ba 'od gnyis kyis// zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa ste// mi la mi sbyin gces par bcang*// bstan na dam tshig nyams zhes gsung*// snod min rnams la gsang bar bya// cod pan mgrin bzang ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so//

༈ /rje btsun lhan cig skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi ltar gtsang rigs lha mo ste// nang ltar rig 'dzin lha mo lnga// a dzi dha ra sa srung ste// gsang ba sngags kyi ḍā ki lnga// 'di dag bsgrub par 'dod pa des// g.ya' ri gangs ri mthon po'am// rdza ri ngos bzang dag la bsgrub// yang na nags ri mthon po'am// nags tshal gling du bsgrub par bya// dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pa yis// sgrub pa'i mthun rdzas bstan pa ni// za 'og dar dkar gur dang ni// ras dkar dag gi gur chung phub// g.yang sha gtsang ma chang phud bcas// g.yang 'phying gtsang ma'i steng du ni// logs la mtshal gyi g.yung drung lnga// phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga ru bya// gro bag phye la rin chen lnga// tsan+dan dkar dmar bsres pa yi// 'bru sna 'bras dkar dag kyang bsre// nas phye ngar btags ra dkar dang*// ba dmar 'o ma chu yis sbru// de la 'brang rgyas lnga dang ni// 'bri lug ra dang rta sbrul dang*// srog chags gzugs ni sna tshogs bya// dud 'gro rnams dang gcan gzan dang*// chu la gnas sogs du ma bya// 'brang rgyas re re'i rtse mo la'ang*// rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs re bskyon// gser skyems gtsang ma g.yu sngon mchod// ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi bya// rgun 'brum la sogs shing tog dang*// rin chen sna lnga dar sna lnga// dar dkar yol ba sbrel ba dang*// maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma'i steng du gzhag /dpon g.yog lnga yi tsakli// rgyan dang bcas pa gzug par bya// rtsi thog mar dang 'o ma dang*// zho dang khur ba la sogs dang*// zhun mar tshogs rdzas mtha' ma bskor// mda' dar me long mu tig dang*// sor gdub g.yu chung gtsang ma dang*// rdzas kyi rim pa bsham par bya// gsang ba'i khyad par rdzas 'di ni// bdud rtsi lnga dang sin+dhu ra// ḍā ki khyad par brten pa'i rdzas// ne le'i blud bur gzhug par bya// dus gsum dag tu gtor ma gtong*// phud kyis mchod cing bskul bar bya// dus ni yar ngo'i tshes lnga nas// phyi ma'i tshes lnga'i bar dag tu// zla ba gcig tu gsang la bsgrub// dam tshig dag ni 'di ltar bsrung*// yugs sa pho mo'i zas dang ni// rta bong sha dang mdze can dang*// nyams pa can dang gtam mi bya// khang rul mi 'gro ral hrul dang*// sa phug 'dre can spang bar bya// tho phyir khyi dang bud med spang*// yang na chu gling dag tu bsgrub// sgom pa'i rim pa 'di ltar bya// dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya// tshogs bsag lha dang bla ma la// yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya// de nas rang nyid skad cig gis// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// lhan cig skyes ma'i skur bsgom zhing*// lhag pa'i bsam pas sems bskyed cing*// tshad med bzhi dang stong par bsgom// de yi ngang las hrīḥlas bskyed// chos 'byung gru gsum yangs pa'i nang*// pam̐ las byung ba'i pad+ma dang*// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ram̐ las nyi dkyil steng du ni// 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng du// jo mo rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug can// g.yon pa thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin// phyag rgya lnga dang 'gying bag can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gcer bu'i gzugs// mi mgo'i cod pan do shal can// sna tshogs dar gyi rgyan gyis mdzes// spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra grol// bde ba'i gar stabs ldan par bsam// de nyid gnas gsum rgyas gdab dang*// ye shes bstim dang dbang bskur ba// mchod bstod byas nas gsang sngags bzla// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra bhā ra hī phaṭa/ ma hā badz+ra yo gi nī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bdud rtsi myang bar byas nas ni// ci rigs par ni gsang sngags 'di// sngags kyi phreng ba mgal me ltar// 'khor ba'i tshul du bzla bar bya// sngags kyi 'od zer du ma yis// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs// las kyi ḍā ki du ma rnams// rang dbang med par bkug nas kyang*// phrin las ci bcol byed par bsam// khyad par ḍā ki sde lnga las// rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sku mdog dkar mo gzhon tshul can// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje 'phyar// g.yon pa tshe yi bum pa 'dzin// bum pa'i steng du dpal be'u dang*// g.yung drung rin chen 'khyil pa dang*// lhab lhub dar gyi rgyan dang bcas// rin chen du mas mdzes pa yi// bkra shis tshe ring gtso mo ni// seng ge dkar mo chibs su bcibs// gangs dkar steng na bzhugs par bsam// lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// rdo rje dpal mo longs spyod yum// sku mdog dmar mo mdangs chags ma// chibs su sha ba yu mo bcibs// phyag g.yas rin chen nor bu dang*// g.yon pa rin chen sgrom bu bsnams// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las bsgrub// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// sku mdog sngon mo 'tsher bag can// rdo rje khros ma zhes byar grags// chibs su rkyang mo kha dkar bcibs// g.yas na dngul gyi me long bsnams// g.yon na lha yi ba dan 'phyar// rnal 'byor phrin las mdzad pa yin// lha mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog /chibs su rgya stag grus ma bcibs// gsang mtshan rdo rje bzhad pa mo// phyag g.yas rin chen gser gzhong na// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams// g.yon na ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams// sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// sku mdog sngo ljang mdangs dang ldan// phyag g.yas rtsa mchog dūr+wa bsnams// g.yon na sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin// g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs su bcibs// gsang mtshan rdo rje gar mkhan ma// khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs kyis// snang srid bdag gi dbang du bsdus// phrin las thogs pa med pa yi// thogs med nus pa 'dir ston cig

/ces brjod pas/ bskul ba/ bskyed pa/ spyan 'dren pa gsum du yod pa dus gcig la bya'o// lha mo 'khor bcas kyis bdag la bskor ba byed par bsams nas sngags 'di bzla bar bya'o// oṃ badz+ra dpe gcig la mi snang*/ ma ma ru ru tsit+ta dha ra me dzu te hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ya tra sing sing hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bi oṃ badz+ra bha ki zhes pa'ang snang*/ kyai mu ta bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra a bhi pra dpe gcig lar snang*/ ni hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pra dpe gcig la badz+ra dang pra mi snang*/ si ra ting ting kha thim ting zhes pa'ang gda'/ dzñā na hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ dam can rtsal dbab pa'i srog gi snying po spyi mthun grags pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra hriṃ hriṃ ma hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mo gha sad+dhi dhe wa pañtsa na badz+ra ra taṃ sa ma ya s+t+wāṃ/ ha sa ra ni tha te ga te tri a bhi ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ spyir bzlas pa bya'o// phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub gsum// sman gyi lha mo bha na ka /nags kyi lha mo pus sing ma// mdangs kyi lha mo pra mo he// rtsa yi lha mo bhi na ka /'od kyi lha mo si ya ri// de ltar rig pa'i lha mo de// nang ltar rig 'dzin lha mo nyid// añdzi dha ra pra bha ka /gsang ba ḍā ki sde lnga ma// dur khrod gnas kyi lha mo de// rnal 'byor kun gyi nyul le ma// bka' nyan lha mo 'bum sder bcas// 'jig rten gsum gyi mnga' bdag mo// bod khams skyong ba'i bstan srung lnga// bdag gi ci 'dod sgrub byed pa'i// dam tshig bskyed la ye shes bstim// dbang bskur rgyas gdab byin brlabs nas// ci 'dod dngos grub byin nas ni// rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol// de nas rtsa ba'i rje btsun ma'i// sku las 'od 'phros khams gsum khyab// sems can don byas tshur 'dus pas// bdag nyid sku la nyer 'dus te// de nas sa bon bam̐ la bstim// 'od gsal ngang las 'da' sa med// rjes la mthun du spyod lam bstan// 'di ni gsang ba'i man ngag ste// lhan cig skyes ma'i snying po yin// mdzes ma rnams la yi dam du// jo mo lhan skyes mngon rtogs bshad// lha mo lnga yis spyan snga ru// gsang ba'i rang srog snying po phul// rje btsun brgyud par bcas pa yi// bka' srung mkha' 'gror dam bcas pas// dam bca' 'gal na dmyal bar 'gro// des na dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsung bzhin sgrubs// bka' srung bka' yi bya ra gyis// skabs su gtor ma 'bul ba ni// rje btsun ma yi gtor ma ni// byin rlabs rgyas par byas nas ni// zhabs su so so'i gtor ma ni// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa ma ma sarba karma dzñā na ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes lan bdun brjod pas 'bul zhing bskul bar bya'o// sgrub pa thon nas gtor ma gtong*// bla rdo rang lus bcang bar bya// dngos grub blangs la phrin las bcol// zhag grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam// yang na zla ba gcig tu bsgrub// 'di ni spogs chog bya mi dgos// nyin re nyams snang rtag tu 'byung*// gsang ba thun mong ma yin pas// bla ma rje btsun gsung las ni// sman btsun ḍā ki lnga po yi// man ngag gsang ba'i sgrom bu 'di// dge bsnyen bho dhi rā dzas rnyed// skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog /// ༈ /gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sngags/ oṃ ka ma wa ti mi thun na pre me ri swā hā/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ na kri ma ti su ru sa ma ti swā hā/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ an+tan rak+ta ni mi thun na pre ye swā hā/ mi g.yo glang bzang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ dha ka sa dha sa ri tsakra mu ni tiṣ+ṭha lo swā hā/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ ḍā ki ka ra gra yu kra pa ni mā ra ya dza dza swā hā// ༈ /rje btsun mi la ras pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la phyi sman mo ltar sgrub pa dang*/ nang rig 'dzin lha mo ltar sgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba ḍā ki ma ltar sgrub pa'o// de yang rdzas ni/ mu tig mig med dam/ nya phyis rnyed na phyi sgrub/ nang sgrub byed par 'dod na/ me long gtsang ma/ gsang ba sor gdub bud med kyis ma reg pa'o// de nas dmigs pa'i khyad par la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu yod pas/ phyi ltar sgrub ste lha mo so so'i snying dkar nag mtshams nas 'od kyis lcags kyu lta bur btab ste rang dbang med par byung nas/ ma ltar byams nas lha mo'i cha byad can// bzhon pa can gyis bskor ba byed par bsam/ sring mo can ltar ni/ 'od kyi lcags kyus lte ba nas drangs te/ sku mdog dkar mo sha stag bzhon pa med pas bdag la bskor ba byas pas/

sring mo ltar gdung bar bsam/ gsang ba bran mo ltar sgrub pa ni/ lcags kyus gsang gnas su btab pas/ bdag la brtse ba'i sgo nas/ bud med dmar mo gcer bu rus rgyan can lngas phyag g.yas na ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pas thod pa'i nang du zhal zas sgrub pa po la stob cing*/ bka' nyan bran bzhin tu 'khor bar bsam/ srog snying dar leb rgan la sgrub pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ sgrub pa thon nas dar dkar la 'khor lo dang srog snying bris la lus la bcang bar bya'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// ༈ /dpal ldan lhan cig skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa nyams su len par 'dod na/ gnas gangs yod pa'i ri mthon por song la/ mthun rkyen 'dzom par byas la/ g.yang phying gtsang ma dang*/ bag phye gtsang ma dang*/ nas dkar mo dar tshags byas pa ba dmar mo'am/ ra dkar mo'i 'o mas sbrus la/ 'brang rgyas lnga/ gtor ma lnga/ g.yang sha lug gi lag g.yas dang*/ nang sha dang*/ rtsi sman dkar gsum dang mngar gsum dang*/ rdzas la dar dkar la lha mo lnga'i srog gi snying po bri/ dar leb rgan la 'khor lo bri/ dar dkar gyi gur lnga'am/ med na gcig dbub/ de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ tshad med pa dang byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ jo mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ rgyan cha lugs dang ldan par gsal ba'am/ bdag nyid kyi yi dam gang yin gang rung ba'i spyi gtsug tu rje btsun mi la ras pa gsal bar bsgom/ de nas lha'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas bkra shis tshe ring ma dpon g.yog lnga lha sman 'bum dang bcas pa rang dbang med par mdun du byung ste/ bdag la bskor ba byed cing phyag byed bka' nyan par bsam/ tsakli lnga bris pa la dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed/ ye shes pa bstims la/ gur de gzhal yas khang du bsam/ 'brang rgyas la sogs pa zas yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas phul bas mnyes par bsam/ 'o ma la ka ra bu ram btab la mchod cing gtor/

sngags brjod cing*/ dmigs pas bdag gi bka' nyan par bsam mo// sngon rje btsun ma ri khrod ta la ma la sogs pa rnams dang*/ bar du slob dpon pad+ma/ da lta rje btsun mi la ras pa'i bka' ma bcag cig bya'o// sku mdog phyag mtshan ni gzhung na gsal/ oṃ si nga si nga hūm̐ nga hūm̐ nga lha nga lha nga

pā tra pā tra gda'/ ya ḍa ya ḍa phaṭa phaṭa dhi si mu khe swā hā/ oṃ la sogs pa gdags/ sngags 'di ci rigs bgrang zhing thun gyi zhabs su gtor ma gtong*/ las bcol te/ bkra shis pa/ tshe ring ba/ dpal bskyed pa/ longs spyod spel ba/ bar chad sol/ bstan pa srungs/ zhes las la sbyar/ tha ma gshegs su gsol/ rtags myur du 'byung*/ cho 'phrul chen po la sogs ngan te mi 'chun pas/ rje btsun ma dang*/ mi la la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis nges par 'grub bo// sgrub pa thon nas mi la rdzas mi sbyin rang bza'o// gtor ma stegs mthon po'i sar gtong*/ de nas lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas las byed bka' nyan no// bkra shis tshe ring ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// ༈ /ngan rdzong snyan brgyud jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// jo mo lha sman tshe dbang ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ phyi sgrub bsnyen pa yin/ nang sgrub sgrub pa yin/ gsang sgrub bsad pa yin/ de kho na nyid spogs pa'i tshul lo// de la phyi sgrub la/ dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi pa de'i steng du gra 'phying gtsang ma'i steng du dar dkar mtho gang pa gcig gding*/ sa gtsang ma la bum sman btab ste gangs kyi gzugs byas pa sa dkar bsres la de'i steng du gzhag de la mda' bya rgod ma la dar sna lnga me long dang mgron bu dang*/ sman bzang drug rnams btags la gzug de'i steng du dar dkar la jo mo'i sku zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma stag mo la chibs pa gcig gangs la gzug de'i mdun tu sman leb la mtshal gyi g.yung drung ris bris pa gzhag chang la bzang drug btab pa yang mdun tu gzhag go /de nas dar dkar gyi gur phub gtor ma rgyan dang bcas pa bsham mo// rang khrus byas spos dkar dud pa dang chu gtor btang la/ bdag sgrub pa byed pa la bar chad gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gtong*/ sum+bhas bgegs bskrad/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu song bas yig brgyas rgyud sbyangs la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis jo mo spyan drangs shing 'khod par bya ste/ oṃ mu haṃ ring gra gra hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ oṃ kha la rak+ṣa rbad/ thum ril bh+yoḥ zhes rtags ma byung bar bzla/ grib dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ mtshams dam pa dang smra ba bcad pa gal che/ mtshams khog tu khyi dang bud med mi btang la/ bstod pa gang shes bya'o// jo mo'i phyi sgrub zab mo*// ༈ /jo mo'i nang sgrub bzhugs so// rje btsun ma la na mo/ nang gnod sbyin mo'am gter sgrub ni/ sngar gyi steng du/ khyad par gyi rdzas lha mo gnod sbyin mo gser gyi mdog 'dra ba g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa bsnams pa sku la rat+na mang pos spras pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba stag mo grus ma bsnol ba'i gdan la phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab shel gyi gangs la gtad pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba rnams kyis sgrub pa po la longs spyod kyi char 'bebs par bsam zhing*/ tsakli bris pa gangs la gzug tsakli de'i mdun tu 'bru sna lngas byas pa'i 'brang rgyas kyi steng du/ yul de na phyug pa'i phu mda' bar gsum gyi zhing mdzod kyi sa spar re dang nas bre gang rgyal lam bre phul gyi skar ma la blangs la phyib pa'i gzugs gcig gsang lug gcig dpal bshos gcig rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs gcig byas la/ mar dang bu ram dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang ka ra byugs la 'brang rgyas khar gzhag sa la rin chen brdar la bzang drug dang bsres la dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbrus/ sman sna tshogs sa dkar gyi gseb tu spos chu dang sbyar la gangs gzugs byas pa gur dkar gyi 'og tu gzhag bag phye'i nang du bzang drug la klu sman btab la chu gtor rgyun mi chad du gtong ngo*// chang phud la rin po che btab pa dang*/

'bras dung*/ rin po che/ 'brang rgyas/ sman leb/ mar/ bu ram rnams kyis dus bzhir mchod/ phud dang gtor ma'i lhag ma dngos grub tu za'o// mdun gyi lha mo rnams kyis bdag la 'bru dang nor longs spyod kyi char dang*/ sa 'og gter gyi dngos grub gnang bar bsams la/ me tog dkar po dang ser po gtor zhing sngags 'di bzla'o// oṃ mu haṃ ring gra gra hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ rat+na sid+dhi bha ku ta ma/ kha la rak+ṣa sid+dhi bh+rūm̐ ri/ zhes bzla'o// phyag rgya'am bud med bzang mos nor ster ba dang*/ sgrub pa pos rin po che dang nor gyi char 'bebs pa rmis na 'grub pa'i rtags so// longs spyod rnams kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ pha ma dang sems can la sbyin par btang na 'di dang phyi mar 'byor pa mi zad par 'byung ste srid pa gsum yang dbang du 'du'o// nang gnod sbyin mo'i tshul du sgrub pa'i gdams pa zab mo*/ sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi lag len dang*/ dam tshig gi rim pa rnams ni phyi sgrub ltar nyams su blang zhing shes par bya'o// shin tu gsang ba gal che'o// ༈ /jo mo'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje la na mo/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro ma'i tshul gyis bstan pa'i dgra bo chom la dbab pa drag po'i mthu sgrub bstan pa ni/ gnas dang rdzas dang bca' gzhi dang*/ lha bsgom zhing thun gyi ting nge 'dzin no// gnas ni dur khrod dam/ mi phung shul lam/ lha khang rnying pa'am/ gangs kyi 'dabs sam/ lha 'dre'i rgyu srang du dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ 'brub khung gru gsum byas la rtsang gis bskor la nang ro sol gyis byug go /dgra bo'i liṅga gro ga la bris la bsad sngags kyis mtha' ma bskor ro// 'bru sna lnga'i phye ma la mā ra'i zag rdzas dang rkang rjes sa grogs mkhar gyi sa dang bsres la rū pa byas la/ liṅga'i spyi gtsug tu gzhug go /'phong na mar thur la brdeg

khrag skam nyungs kar/ nyungs nag la sogs thun rdzas rnams dug chus bran la/ thun mtshon cha'i char du bsam mo// lha bsgom pa ni rang yi dam gang rung du bsgom mo// mdun du mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum spyan dgu nyi zla ltar 'bar ba'i sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad pa/ sku stod ral pa 'bum gyis brgyan pa/ zhal khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas pas gri gug gdengs pa'i tshul du bsnams pa/ g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa kha phye nas bstan pa 'jig par byed pa rnams la tsha ba'i nad kyi dbal gtor ba/ lce bar snang gi khams khebs pas dgra bo'i bla 'tshol ba/ ral pa bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas thog dang ser ba'i bu yugs 'phen pa/ zhabs gnyis stag mo rol pa'i gdan steng na dor stabs su bgrad pa/ seng ge dkar mo rol du khrid pa brjid pa'i sku ri rab dang mnyam pa'o// de'i mdun na sha za dang*/ ma mo dang*/ mon mo dang*/ ḍā ki ma rnams ni dgra bo'i sha za khrag 'thung*/ ro la zhon/ lpags la gyon/ klad pa ldag 'o dod 'bod/ rgya mtsho hub kyis 'thungs kyang nga mi ngoms/ srid gsum zas su zos kyang mi 'grangs zer ba rnams so// mo'i g.yas na gdon chen bco brgyad ni/ phyag na ral gri dang*/ be con/ tho ba/ dgra s+t+wa/ dbyug to/ zhags pas 'chings/ gri gug gis gtub/ ba dan dmar nag 'phyar ba/ ro langs la zhon nas bswos 'debs pa'o// mo'i g.yon na/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga ni/ stag chas dang*/ gzig chas/ gung chas can rnams ni go cha sra zhing mtshon rno ba rnams so// mo'i rgyab nas gzhug sdud pa ni/ phyogs skyong ba bcu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so so rang rang gi chas dang*/ phyag mtshan bsnams nas phyi'i rting skul mdzad pa'o// mdun gyi liṅga bstan pa'i dgra bo dngos su bsams pa'i steng na mang la/ khro mo 'khor bcas kyis sngags mtshon cha'i bu yugs dang thog ser du phab pas/ sho mangs la ser ba rgyab pa bzhin du bsams la/

sngags 'di bzla/ oṃ mu haṃ ring gra gra hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ oṃ kha la rak+ṣa rbad/ che ge mo'i srog la thuṃ ril bh+yo/ zhes thun gyis brab/ sha khrag gi gtor ma bzang pos mchod/ bstod pa dang bskul ba drag po bya'o// de ltar byas pas rtags ni/ rmi lam du gsod pa dang*/ gtub pa dang*/ nang rol za ba dang*/ bla 'dod pa dang*/ zhags pa 'debs pa/ khrid nas bsad cing za ba rnams 'byung ngo*// rtags de rnams byung ba dang*/ zhag bdun drag po'i phur pas gdab/ mtshon gyis gtubs la/ dgra bo me ru bsreg par liṅga bsreg de nas liṅga gsar pa gcig dang bcas pa mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan pa bya/ yang na klu gnas pa'i sar mnan no// bskul yang yang bya'o// sha za ḍā ki'i srog tig dgra bo'i srog mchan 'di/ bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la bya yi/ gzhan du sdig che bas gsang ngo*// bskul byed na/ bh+yo/ ma mo chen mo srog bdag mo// sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la// zhal gsum spyan dgu nyi ltar gsal// 'bar ba'i sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad// sku stod ral pa 'bum gyis brgyan// zhal ni khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// phyag g.yas gri gug dgra la 'debs// g.yon pas nad kyi ser ba 'bebs// leb rgan ljags dmar glog ltar 'khyug /ral pa bsigs pas stong gsum khengs// thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'phen// stag mo rol pa'i steng du bzhugs// rol du seng ge dkar po khrid// brjid pa'i sku la 'bar ba'i nyams// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// khyod kyi sngon nas las byed ma// sha za ma mo mon mo dang*// ḍā ki dam can rgya mtsho rnams// sha la dga' zhing khrag la 'thung*// ro la zhon nas pags la gon// klad pa ldag cing 'o dod 'bod// rgya mtsho btungs kyang mi ngoms shing*// srid gsum zos kyang 'grangs pa med// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// g.yas kyi gdon chen bco brgyad ni// phyag na ral gri be con dang*// tho ba dgra s+t+wa dbyug to bsnams// zhags pas 'chings shing mtshon gyis gtub// ba dan dmar nag dgra la 'phyar// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// khyod kyi g.yon nas ru 'dren pa// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga ni// stag gzig gung gi pho chas can// go cha sra zhing mtshon cha rno// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// khyod kyi rgyab nas rting skul ba// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas rnams// rang rang phyag mtshan mtshon cha bsnams// dgra bo'i tshe srog chod la shog

/khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo// zhes bskul lo// kha thaṃ// / ༈ /jo mo'i de kho na nyid kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje la na mo/ de kho na nyid la ma mo dbang du 'dus pas/ dgra bo rngam zhing 'bros su gzhug pa ni/ rdzas bca' zhing bsten pa dang*/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bstan pa/ las la sbyor ba'o// rdzas ni ltas ngan gyi sha khrag gang rnyed sa bzang gi gseb tu btab la mi'i lus po la bya'i mgo bo gsum yod pa kha gdangs pa/ lus la mtshe dang nyungs kar dang ltas ngan gyi spu sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phrag pa g.yas su 'ug pa/ g.yon na bya rog spyi gtsug na srin bya/ lag pa g.yas khram shing*/ g.yon srin bya/ sku la ltas can sna tshogs bsgoms la/ dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi'i dbus gru gsum nang du liṅga dgug gzhug byas la gzhug de'i kha khyer la sku gzugs de gzhug dbus su dmar gtor che ba gcig mañdzi'i khar gzhag go /de'i phyogs bzhi'i shar du wa la spre'u zhon pa bzhag lhor bya rog 'ug pa la zhon pa/ nub tu bu chung gla ba la zhon pa/ byang du rgan mo phag la zhon pa'i spyi gtsug na srin bya khus 'debs pa'o// de tshe yang so so'i sha khrag yod na rab/ med kyang bya'o// yi dam rta mgrin bsgoms la lta ba chos nyid kyi gdengs dang ldan par bya'o// snying ga nas hūm̐ dang dza la 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bdud mo'i cha lugs can 'khor bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bya zhing brtan par bya/ de nas sngags 'dis bskul lo// oṃ mu haṃ ring gra gra hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ oṃ kha la rak+ṣa rbad// dgra bo che ge mo la ltas ngan sna tshogs phob/ thuṃ ril thuṃ ril bh+yoḥ zhes bzlas pas sku las ltas ngan sna tshogs 'phros pas/ la la dgra'i khang thog na lding*/ la la gos kyis steng dang sgyed po'i kha la 'bab/

la la mal sa na zhugs shing skad sna tshogs 'don par bsgom mo// rang gi khang par ltas ngan byung na 'grub pa'i rtags yin pas/ dgra bo'i phyogs su kha bltas la rbad par bya'o// de nas yang rtags de rnams drwa bar bcug nas dgra phyogs su bskyal/ gtor ma dmar chen zor du 'phen/ yas rtags ji ltar byas pa bzhin du 'ong ngo*// nga mi 'dis btang ba yin zer nas 'babs so// babs su byung na mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la gtang rag bzang du gtong ngo*// de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa gang byed kyang*/ sngon 'gro gnas khang skyang nul bya ba dang*/ rang khrus bya/ chu gtor gtong*/ sāts+tsha gdab/ spang skong klog bka' brgyud rnams la gsol ba gdab/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug pa gal che'o// dam tshig la dge ba'i phyogs dang du blang*/ gtsang sbra thon par bya/ 'khon dang thab gzhob mi gtong*/ yugs sa dang bsnol la sogs pa mi bsten/ de ltar byas na nyams bzang po mngon shes 'dra ba 'byung*/ phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad sel/ mthu dang cho 'phrul las sbyor ni/ 'khor ma thub pa'am/ bstan pa 'jig pa la thug na bya yi/ gzhan gar gar byas na bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad yong ngo*// rang bde bas mi chog sems can thams cad bde dgos so// 'di rje btsun gyi yon bdag mo'ang yin/ mu drar yang zhabs tog mdzad pa'i mngon shes can/ res lus mi snang par byed/ res ri khrod dang grog phug na bzhugs pa gcig la brin du zhus so// // ༈ /dbang phyug tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dbang phyug tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ tshe ring ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i gang zag gis dben pa'i gnas su gzhi bzang po'i khar mañdzi la sogs pa'i stegs cung zad mtho ba'i steng du tshe bum/ tshe chang*/

tshe ril/ tshe gtor/ de'i mdun du sman mo lnga'i gtor ma gangs gzugs lnga la so so'i tsakli btsugs pa'i mthar/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis bskor/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings nang rdzas gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ nang mchod/ lha mo lnga'i phyag mtshan sogs bsham/ mchod pa rnams sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par byas rjes/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du/ hrīḥlas rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can 'gying bag dang ldan zhing*/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ rtsa zhal cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum dang ldan pa mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ g.yas phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrogs pa/ rab brjid drag mo'i dpal dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams shing mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la dril bu g.yer kha 'phan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa 'chang ba/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa la me tog gis brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/

gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yam̐/ hrīṃ mā+oṃ/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ hum̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ phaiṃ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng g.yon skor dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi ye shes bdag gi rgyud la zhugs/ sdig sgrib dag tshe dpal ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa la thim/ de chos 'byung la thim/ chos 'byung gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim/ rang nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim/ de mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /mdun bskyed sgrub pa la gsum las/ dang po ni tshe bum/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal bsal/ tshe srog rgud pa las bskyabs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po bye ru'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha byad can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar kha'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba can du gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ a mi tā bha wa sogs mtshan sngags re re sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i tshe gzungs ci rigs bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dus min gyi 'chi ba bsal nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las bum pa spyi ltar bskyed pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag shar du rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag byang du don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag thams cad kyang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs lngas rgyas gdab/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces dang*/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥrnams ci nus dang*/ tshe gzungs ci rigs bzlas rjes gzungs thag bsdus la/ gong ltar mchod bstod yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ gsum pa chos skyong gtso 'khor bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi gzhir pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan lnga'i dbus su mam̐ las jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar mo seng ge dkar mo la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa tshe'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir nam mkha' la gdengs pa/ g.yon tshe'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad khro ba/ dung gi thor tshugs can dar man+t+ra kha'i na bza' kha dog mi 'dra ba sum brtsegs gsol ba/ de'i shar du iṃ las mthing gi zhal bzang ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing ga rkyang bu kha dkar la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'phrul gyi me long la blta ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon ba dan nang du g.yob pa/ in+d+ra nī la'i thor tshugs can/ lhor am̐ las mi g.yo glang bzang ma rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser mo/ stag mo grus ma la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon ro mchog brgya pa'i zhal zas kyis gang ba'i gzhong pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/

g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon pa'i gzhong pa nas blangs nas ster ba'i tshul mdzad pa/ gser gyi thor tshugs can/ nub tu tsam̐ las cod pan mgrin bzang ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo sha ba yu mo la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon nor gyi bang mdzod kyi sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ bye ru'i thor tshugs can/ byang du tam̐ las gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang gu g.yu 'brug sngon mo la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas na rtswa dūr+wa'i chun po dang*/ g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ g.yu'i thor tshugs can/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa/ lha dang mi'i rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ srab 'jam kha dog bzang po'i na bza' gsol ba/ 'khor lha ma srin rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bkra shis mthon mthing ri'i rgyal mo nas/ dbang phyug tshe ring mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sha chen spos dkar sogs bsregs la rdor dril 'dzin pas ngag tu/ bh+yo/ sngon tshe dur khrod bsil tshal du// mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// sngon tshe kha la rong sgo ru// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// sngon tshe sman lung chu bar du// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje yi// spyan sngar thugs dam zhal bzhes pa'i// mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs// phyi ltar lha sman chen mo lnga// nang ltar zhing skyong mkha' 'gro lnga// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// sde brgyad du ma'i 'khor bcas rnams// rnal 'byor sgrub po 'khor bcas la// thugs dam brtse bas dgongs mdzod nas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ maṅga laṃ ā yuḥpuṇ+ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa e h+ye hi/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ mām̐ lām̐ ām̐ tsām̐ tām̐ pañtsa ḍā kī nī sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dam tshig phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang rnal 'byor pa bdag la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren gdug pa can rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad thal bar rdul du brlag pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe ring zhing 'gro don 'phel ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces dam la bzhag mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ rab brjid gangs dkar gur gyi nang dbus su// sna tshogs rin chen brtsegs pa'i gdan khri la// lha yi dar gyi g.yogs mas bkab pa'i steng*// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /bkra shis rtags brgyad rin chen bdun// khang bzang skyed tshal gos dang rgyan// bzhon pa 'bru sna rin po che// go mtshon gnag phyugs la sogs pa// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul rnams kyis// sman btsun mched lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag mi shes rmongs pa'i mthus// lus ngag yid kyis nongs bgyis te// thugs dang 'gal bar gang gyur pa// byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol// bh+yo/ chos sku skye ba med pa las// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa yi// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad pa'i// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga la bstod// ces dang*/

bstod pa rgyas pa la spro na gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o// tshe gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gyur/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pas dbul mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs 'dod don zhu/ chos skyong ma'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ mām̐ lām̐ ām̐ tsām̐ tām̐ pañtsa ḍā kī nī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ gong ltar phyi mchod kyis mchod/ pañtsa ḍā ki nī añdzi dha rī swāhā oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la/ gong gi bstod pa'i mthar/ sman btsun chen mo 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi ltar brjod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi lha mo lnga'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog thugs rgyud bskul te sman btsun ma mched lnga rang rang gi dngos grub rnams rang nyid la stsol bar bsams la/ oṃ mam̐ maṅga la ā yur puṇ+ya añdzi dha ra swā hā/ oṃ iṃ in+d+ra nī la mu kha bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ oṃ am̐ a tsa la ha na bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ oṃ tsam̐ mu ku ṭa ma dhu ra bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ oṃ tam̐ tad bha dzñā na ka ra bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ 'dod don gsol nas dam tshig dang ldan zhing don gnyer kyi slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par gsal gdab/

lo rgyus brjod par spro na/ rje btsun chen po bzhad pa'i rdo rje des rje mar pa'i drung du dka' ba mang du spyad cing*/ gdams ngag zab pa dang rgya che ba du ma zhus te/ gnas byin rlabs can sman lung chu bar du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i dus/ bkra shis tshe ring mas gtso byas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga la sogs pa snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyis gnam sa bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te/ ting nge 'dzin la bar chad byed du byung bar/ rje btsun chen po de nyid skye ba med pa'i don la snang ba phyogs med du gzigs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin la rtsal 'byongs/ rig pa 'od gsal gyi mdongs thon pa'i stobs kyis/ sku lus gzung 'dzin gyi phung po la zhen pa med par mchod sbyin du bsngos pas/ de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma de dag shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod nas gus pas btud/ bshags pa phul/ da phyin rje btsun chen po'i bka' dang dam la mi 'da' zhing bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis de rnams bka' 'bangs bgyid pa gtsigs la phab/ dam la btags/ dbang dang gdams ngag tshe ring skor gsum dbang bzhi mdud grol la sogs pa gnang*/ de dag gis rang rang gi srog snying dang so so'i phrin las 'di bsgrub ces pa'i dngos grub re phul/ rjes 'jug chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi'ang bka' srung byed par dam bcas/ rje btsun la dan rdzong ras pa dang*/ ras pa zhi ba 'od gnyis kyis bgros te yang yang zhus pas/ lhan cig skyes ma'i mngon rtogs/ tshe dpag med kyi dbang*/ tshe ring ma'i rjes gnang ngo sprod rnams mdzad nas thugs dgyes bzhin tu gnang*/ nyams su len pa'i sgom chen nam/ snod ldan byung na ma gtogs ma sbyin/ dbus na mar na bskur la spyir theg pa chen po'i chos la mkhas pa dgos/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi chos mang du mkhyen pa/ chos 'di la mos pa 'gro don nus pa gcig la byin gsungs/

ngan rdzong ras pas gung thang ras chung pa dang*/ 'om chung ras pa gnyis la gnang*/ gung thang pa la rje btsun gyi zhal gdams brjod nas dbus su btang*/ khong gi gos kyi gong bar bcug pas gong khug mar grags/ dbus su slob ma'i snod brtags pas/ dge bshes rgya pho ba lung pa/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i skye ba yin zhes grags/ de bla ma'i lung dang mthun par byung nas de la gnang*/ de nas rim par brgyud de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ de lta bu'i rjes gnang zab mo bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad sngon tu legs par grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ zhes brjod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas gnang bar mdzod ces pa'i bar dang*/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar steng gi cha la bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ tshe dpag tu med pa rnams bzhugs pa la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la tshe ring ma mched lnga bzhugs pa rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig sgrib bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog gi bar dang de rnams kyis sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnams legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi la spyi bor tshe dbang bskur ba/ rigs lnga'i chu dbang sbyin pa/ chos skyong ma'i rjes gnang bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po tshe dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ ces dang slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su slob ma rnal 'byor mar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ de'i spyi bor ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan la rje btsun bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/

kā shi ka'i ras kyi na bza' gsol ba/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ dbu skra se bun ne ba/ rdo rje'i glu dbyangs len pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug la reg pa/ de'i dbu thog tu rma byas bteg pa'i sogs nas gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar gong bzhin brjod/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang 'og min dang*/ bde ba can sogs nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs nas khyed rang rnams dam tshig sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgoms pa la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum mam tshe gzungs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya a a a/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes sogs yang yang*/ spos rol bya/ de nas spyi bor bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med dang*/ rje btsun la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i nas phyag 'tshal lo// gangs can rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon gyis ma gos pa// mi la zhes byar yongs grags pa'i// pha ras pa de la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba nyams pa/ gzhan gyis ngan thabs byas pa/ 'dre srin gdug pa can gyis bla tshe gzhom pa/ ban bon mthu bo ches bkug cing khyer ba rnams bkug phyi rol 'byung ba bzhi'i nang na gnas pa'i 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub/ zag bcas 'khor ba pa dang*/ zag med mya ngan las 'das pa'i bcud mthu stobs yon tan thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye len pa ltar bsdus nas tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par zhugs/ khol zhing lud pa'i rgyun rje btsun chen po'i dbu gtsug tu zhugs/

sku gang*/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas brdol/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ 'khor 'das shes bya'i yon tan rdzogs shing*/ 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa las grol nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub la brtan pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces tshe bum slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing tshe gzungs brjod/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ chos skyong srung mar bcas pas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la 'chi ba med pa tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes dang tshe ril tshe chang byin la/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar bgyi// zhal zas bsten pas nad kun la// grol bar the tshom bya mi dgos// zhes pa'i mthar lo brgya thub cing sogs shis brjod bya/ gnyis pa rigs lnga'i chu dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i gnas lngar/ seng ge/ rma bya/ glang chen/ rta mchog mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i khri pad zlas mtshan pa las/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ āḥ dpral bar rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ mgrin par 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam gzhag snying gar mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon mnyam gzhag lte bar rin 'byung ser po mchog sbyin mnyam gzhag gsang bar don grub ljang gu skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing mtshan dpes spras pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams khyab/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang ye shes kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi kha dog lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas lngar thim par mos/

de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang lha rnams dang*/ slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar mos/ zhes bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi skur gyur pa// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis// spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo ru// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes brjod la bum chu sbyin/ bum pa ltag par bzhag sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gyur pa// bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyis// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub= oṃ pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ bum pa dpral bar/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs gyur pa// bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje yis// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru// 'chi med tshe yi= oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum pa rna ltag g.yas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan mchog /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan gyis// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru// 'chi med tshe yi= oṃ rat+na ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ bum pa rna ltag g.yon/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las bdag /bcom ldan don yod grub pa yis// gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo ru// 'chi med tshe yi= oṃ karma ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de ltar dbang bskur bas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gnas lngar rigs lngas dbur brgyan par mos/ de ltar dbang bskur bas gti mug la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga dag rnam snang la sogs pa'i dbang lnga thob/ gzugs phung la sogs pa'i phung po lnga gnas gyur/ chos dbyings la sogs pa ye shes lnga mngon du byas/ rigs lnga'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs nas shog gi bar brjod la me tog gtor/ de rnams kyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang legs par grub nas/

gsum pa chos skyong ma'i rjes gnang bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi gzhir sogs ces dam bzhag gi bar gong gi mngon rtogs ltar brjod/ de nas tshe ring ma'i gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid can// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs pa// tshe 'phel rigs brgyud dngos grub stsol// oṃ mam̐ maṃ ga la ā yuḥpuṇ+ya añdzi dha ra swā hā/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro bkra shis tshe ring ma 'khor dang bcas pa dbang phyug bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa brtan par mdzod la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang dam ldan rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang*/ srid srungs/ rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ shar phyogs kyi gtor ma/ lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid= mi 'gyur yon tan kun= snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ iṃ in+d+ra nī la mu kha bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing gi zhal bzang ma 'khor dang bcas pa= snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsal du= lho'i gtor ma/ lha mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis= mi 'gyur yon tan= rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub= oṃ am̐ a tsa la ha na bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ rin chen mkha' 'gro mi g.yo blo bzang ma 'khor dang bcas pa= rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub= nub kyi gtor ma/ lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis= mi 'gyur yon tan= bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ tsam̐ mu ku ṭa ma dhu ra bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro cod pan mgrin bzang ma 'khor= bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub=

byang gi gtor ma/ lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// dpal 'bar= mi 'gyur yon tan= rkang bzhi phyugs 'phel dngos grub stsol// oṃ tam̐ tad bha dzñā na ka ra bha dra añdzi dha ra swā hā/ las kyi mkha' 'gro gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma 'khor= rkang bzhi phyugs 'phel ba'i= de rnams kyis gtor ma'i rjes gnang grub nas/ de nas dngos grub kyi rjes gnang gi slad du phyag mtshan rnams rim par lag tu gtad par mos/ gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mtshar sdug tu chags shing rgyan dang na bza' mdzes par byas pas srid srung rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub kyi rjes/ rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pas khyed rang rnams la gus pa'i tshul gyis bskor ba ling ling byed cing kho mo'i ming ni bkra shis tshe ring ma zhes bgyi ba lags te/ tshe dang rigs brgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags so// zhes brjod pa'i mos pa mdzod cig dbyangs dang bcas te/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la// srid srung tshe yi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ mam̐ maṅga la= lha mo ming gi zhal bzang ma mtshar sdug= mdzes par byas pas snang gsal pra yi dngos grub kyi rdzas me long dang mda' dar 'dzin= ming ni mthing gi zhal bzang ma zhes bgyi ba lags te/ snang gsal pra yi dngos grub 'bul/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i= ji ltar khas= skal ldan rigs kyi= snang gsal pra yi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ iṃ in+d+ra nī la= slar yang lha mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma mtshar sdug= mdzes par byas pas rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub kyi kha zas kyis bkang ba'i snod 'dzin/ ming ni mi g.yo blo bzang ma zhes bgyi ba lags te/ rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub= bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i= ji ltar= skal ldan rigs= rma g.yang= oṃ am̐ a tsa la= slar yang lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma mtshar sdug= mdzes par byas pas bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub kyi rdzas rin po che dang des gang ba'i sgrom bu 'dzin/

ming ni cod pan mgrin bzang ma zhes bgyi ba lags te/ bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub= bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i= ji ltar khas= skal ldan rigs= bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub 'bul// oṃ tsam̐ mu ku ṭa= slar yang lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma mtshar sdug= mdzes par byas pas rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub kyi rdzas rtswa dūr+wa'i chun po dang sbrul zhags 'dzin/ ming ni gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma zhes bgyi ba lags te/ rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub= bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i= ji ltar= skal ldan= rkang bzhi phyugs 'phel dngos grub 'bul// oṃ tam̐ tad bha= 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ des dngos gzhi legs par grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod sogs cha shas kyi longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs yod na longs spyad/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ bsang sbyangs byin brlabs la/ tshe dpag med kyi mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ tshe ring ma la mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ chos sku skye ba sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don zhu/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tsakli la brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par gzhag am̐ bam̐ sogs brjod pas bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya'o// de ltar bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa mdor bsdus pa 'di rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du/ mtshungs med ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shākya'i dge slong mchog legs rdo rjes shrī na len+d+rar sbyar ba'o//

༈ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i gsol mchod mdor bsdus pa bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// btud nas de yi rnam 'phrul las// yongs shar sman btsun mched lnga yi// gsol mchod snying por dril te bshad// de'ang dben pa'i gnas su mchod gtor sogs tshogs par byas nas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon tu 'gro bas yo byad rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las dar dkar gyi gur khyim yangs shing rgya che ba bkod pas mdzes pa'i dbus su lha rdzas dang ting nge 'dzin las grub pa'i mchod gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por gyur par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ de nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo gsal gdab pa ni/ chos kun gnas lugs gzod ma nas// stong nyid spros mtshan las 'das kyang*// snang tshul rten cing 'brel 'byung gi// rnam rol 'gags pa med pa'i rtsal// khor yug gangs ris bskor ba'i dbus// spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs dang*// bdud rtsi'i chu gter 'khyil pa'i gzhir// sprin dang na bun 'khrigs pa'i klong*// zla zhun thags su btags pa ltar// rab dkar kā shi'i lding gur ni// dbang po'i gzhu yi tshon ris can// yangs shing rgya che bkod legs par// rgyal kun yum gcig rnal 'byor ma'i// ye shes lnga yi rnam 'phrul las// yongs shar gangs can bod yul 'dir// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma'i gtso// dbus su bkra shis tshe ring ma// dkar gsal rdo rje tshe bum bsnams// chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs// mdun du mthing gi zhal bzang sngo// 'phrul gyi me long ba dan g.yob// chibs su rkyang mo kha dkar bcibs// g.yas su mi g.yo glang bzang ser// ro mchog brgya ldan zas gzhong bsnams// chibs su rgya stag grus ma bcibs// rgyab tu cod pan mgrin bzang dmar// rin chen gter gyi sgrom bu 'dzin// chibs su sha ba yu mo bcibs// g.yon tu gtad dkar 'gro bzang ljang*// rtswa mchog dūrba sbrul zhags gdengs// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo bcibs// kun kyang dar dang rat+nas brgyan// rin chen sna lnga'i thor tshugs can// mtshar sdug 'od chags gzi byin 'bar// 'dzum zhing dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs// 'khor du brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// lha sman 'bum phrag grangs med sogs// sprul dang las mdzad bsam mi khyab// so so'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*// rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis bal bod mtshams// bkra shis lhun chags gangs kyi ri// mthon mthing rgyal mo'i pho brang nas// sman btsun 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// bskyed pa'i rten la gnyis med thim// phrin las ci bcol byed par gyur// spyan 'dren pa ni/

bh+yo/ rdo rje btsun mo seng ge'i gdong*// brtul zhugs grub pa pad+ma 'byung*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bzhad pa rje// sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i mdun// ji ltar zhal bzhes deng dgongs la// brgyud 'dzin bdag gis 'bod pa'i tshe// sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched dang sprul pa yang 'khor bcas// dngos grub 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs phyir// ma thogs myur du da tshur byon// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa ma ma sarba karma dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkhar byon pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs mdun bskyed dang dbyer med du bsam/ slar yang nam mkha'i khams gang lhas// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas// sku gang sgrib dag rnal 'byor ma// lhan cig skyes mas dbur brgyan gyur// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ mgron rigs 'khor bcas ljags hūm̐ las// rdo rje rtse gcig rnam pa yi// 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud// drangs te zag med bde bas tshim// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa ma ma sarba karma dzñā na ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis dbul/ spro na thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bya/ gang ltar yang mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rdzas las grub ting 'dzin mthus// byin brlabs rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin// phyogs dus kun tu mi zad pas// sman btsun chen mo 'khor bcas mchod// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa ma ma sarba karma dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bh+yo/ phyi ltar gtsang rigs lha mo ste// nang ltar rig 'dzin lha mo lnga// añdzi dha ra sa srung ste// gsang ba sngags kyi ḍā ki lnga// don dam bde chen ye shes dbyings// gcig nyid du ma'i rnam rol can// sman btsun chen mo 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// phrin las gsol ba ni/ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga dang*// bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs// snang srid ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs// sngon tshe ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong can dang*// 'chi med pad+ma saṃ bha was// dbang bskur rdo rje'i dam tshig bstan// khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis// mdzes ma rnams la yi dam du// jo mo lhan skyes mngon rtogs phog

/lha mo lnga yis spyan snga ru// gsang ba'i rang srog snying po phul// rje btsun brgyud par bcas pa yi// bka' srung mkha' 'gror dam bcas pas// dam bca' 'gal na dmyal bar 'gro// de bas dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsung bzhin sgrubs// bka' srung bka' yi bya ra gyis// ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i// mchod gtor rgya chen 'di bzhes la// gangs can ljongs kyi bstan dang 'gror// phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas pa dang*// khyad par bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams// sku tshe phrin las phyogs brgyar spel// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad gdon bar chad bsrung ba dang*// mi mthun phyogs kun nyer zhi zhing*// bkra shis tshe ring dpal 'byor skyed// srid dang zhi ba'i dge mtshan rnams// thogs pa med par dbang du sdus// mdor na chos mthun bsam sbyor kun// yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa'i mthar gtor mgron gyi gtso mo rnams rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs su gsol/ 'khor rnams kyang dgyes bzhin gshegs par bsam/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang du 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs la blo gzhag par bya'o// sman btsun chen mo mched lnga yi// gsol mchod 'jug bde snying po'i phul// grub pa'i zhal lung la sbyar bas// bkra shis char chen 'bebs gyur cig /ces pa'ang rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa mañdzu gho ṣas sbyar ba dge legs kyi pad+mo mchog tu rgyas par sid+dhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
